A memory formed in a high-assurance location is recalled only in that location

claim: A memory carried out of a location that now lets nothing out is recalled only in that location
Outside a sealed source location, nothing carried out of one is recalled; what was carried out of an open location is unaffected
assumes: sealedSrcs = the locations in srcs whose environment has an empty carry_out

claim: Recall is allowed exactly when R1–R4 and R8 all hold (no other way in, and nothing they allow is refused)
Recall is possible at all (the policies are not vacuously safe)
Nothing formed in a high-assurance location is carried out
A memory is carried out only if its type is one every source environment lets out
assumes: carryTypes = the memory types every location's environment lets out

claim: Only an agent who holds the memory's identity and participant labels can carry it out
A memory is carried out only where its source is readable (the carrier is in every one of its locations)
Carry-out is allowed exactly when C1–C4 all hold
Carry-out is possible at all
No agent writes under another agent's identity label
A writer either writes under its own identity or is one of the participants
A memory with a location label is written only in that location
Anything written in a high-assurance location carries that location's label
A memory with a source label is written only in that source location
A write is allowed exactly when W1–W4 and W7 all hold
Writing is possible at all
